description: Caddy is a web server and reverse proxy that obtains and renews HTTPS certificates automatically. Covers reverse proxying, load balancing, file serving, redirects, headers, rate limiting, and configuration through the admin API. Use when tasks involve serving websites, proxying to backend services, automatic TLS certificate management, or replacing Nginx with a simpler configuration.
